label: Latest posts
when: the newest posts as a short list of titles, with date or excerpt if wanted (for a grid or cards of posts use spectra/post)
rules: One self-closing comment, no inner blocks. It fills itself with the site's newest published posts, each title linking to its post, so never write titles or links. Write only the attributes wanted: "postsToShow" (how many, default 5); "displayPostDate", "displayAuthor" and "displayFeaturedImage" as true; "displayPostContent":true with "excerptLength" (words, default 55) for an excerpt under each title. Never set "categories", "selectedAuthor", "layout", "order", "orderBy" or "displayPostContentRadio". A heading goes above it. For a grid or cards of posts use spectra/post.
example:
Latest news

From the blog
